justification: HOLY COW, folks, three of my regulars turn up on the bye-week report this mornin' - Jordan Love, Bijan Robinson, and Hunter Henry all sittin' home with their feet up - but Harry Caray didn't get into this racket starin' at a bunch of zeroes on the lineup card! Aaron Rodgers steps right back into that quarterback bullpen like he never left the mound, D'Andre Swift - a CHICAGO BEAR, be still my heart, folks - trots out at running back off an eighteen-point forecast, and T.J. Hockenson slides in at tight end even wearin' a Questionable tag, 'cause a little soreness never kept a good ballplayer outta a ballgame. Isaiah Likely stays locked in that flex spot after torchin' the league for twenty-three big ones last week, Zay Flowers and Stefon Diggs both found paydirt and keep their jobs, Aaron Jones keeps truckin' at the other running back spot, Boswell's still my man at kicker, and the Ravens D rounds out the lineup card. We don't duck a bye week around here, we cobble together the best doggone nine we got and go play it straight at Coach Taylor's throat - may the best bats win!
forum_post: Three fellas on the bye this week and I didn't blink, folks - swapped in Rodgers, Swift, and Hockenson quicker than you can say 'holy cow' and the lineup's still loaded top to bottom! Coach Taylor, buddy, clear eyes, full hearts, this oughta be a heckuva ballgame - may the best bats win, see you Sunday!
